intro: Johannesburg rewards visitors with world-class museums, lively food scenes and easy day trips. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Gautrain is the fast, safe rail link between OR Tambo, Sandton, Rosebank and Pretoria.
Metrorail commuter trains are cheap but not advised for tourists.
City and Putco buses are limited; minibus taxis are cheap but risky for visitors.
Uber and Bolt work well; use comfort or black options where possible.
Renting a car gives the most flexibility; traffic peaks 06:30-09:00 and 15:30-18:30.
Walking is fine in malls and some suburbs; avoid walking between distant areas.

apartheid-museum.name: Apartheid Museum
apartheid-museum.price_text: ≈ ZAR 120–170 adult · check on the day
apartheid-museum.tip: Allow at least two hours. The walk-through history is heavy, so go early and take it slowly.

constitution-hill.name: Constitution Hill
constitution-hill.price_text: ≈ ZAR 80–120 guided tour · check on the day
constitution-hill.tip: Join a guided tour. The old prison cells and the Constitutional Court are the highlights.

mandela-house.name: Mandela House
mandela-house.price_text: ≈ ZAR 80–120 adult · check on the day
mandela-house.tip: Small house, big story. Combine it with the Vilakazi Street walk nearby.

hector-pieterson.name: Hector Pieterson Memorial
hector-pieterson.tip: The photo of Hector carried by his brother is the image to remember. A local guide adds a lot.

gold-reef-city.name: Gold Reef City
gold-reef-city.price_text: ≈ ZAR 250–450 theme park entry · check on the day
gold-reef-city.tip: The underground mine tour is separate from the rides. Book ahead on weekends.

ponte-city.name: Ponte City
ponte-city.price_text: View from the street free · rooftop tours vary
ponte-city.hours: Exterior always visible · interior by tour only
ponte-city.tip: The cylindrical tower is best seen from the street. Do not wander the building alone.

sab-world-of-beer.name: SAB World of Beer
sab-world-of-beer.price_text: ≈ ZAR 100–150 incl. tasting · check on the day
sab-world-of-beer.tip: Tours run on a schedule. The tasting at the end is the fun part.

fnb-stadium.name: FNB Stadium
fnb-stadium.price_text: Tours vary · match tickets priced per event
fnb-stadium.hours: Event days only for matches · tours by booking
fnb-stadium.tip: Check the fixture list. A match here is the real experience.

carnival-city.name: Carnival City
carnival-city.price_text: Entry free · casino and shows priced separately
carnival-city.tip: It is far east of the city. Only worth the trip if you are staying nearby.

castle-brewery.name: Castle Brewery
castle-brewery.tip: Book ahead. Brewery tours are not always open to the public.

emperors-palace.name: Emperors Palace
emperors-palace.price_text: Entry free · casino, shows and dining priced separately
emperors-palace.tip: Close to the airport. Handy for a last night before a flight.

monte-casino.name: Monte Casino Entertainment Complex
monte-casino.price_text: Entry free · dining and shows priced separately
monte-casino.tip: The domed complex is a good rainy-day stop in the northern suburbs.

nandos.name: Nando's
nandos.tip: Peri-peri chicken is a South African staple. Ask for mild if you are unsure.

orlando-towers.name: Orlando Towers
orlando-towers.price_text: View free · bungee and tours priced separately
orlando-towers.hours: Exterior always visible · activities by booking
orlando-towers.tip: The painted cooling towers are a Soweto icon. Bungee jumps need advance booking.

satyagraha-house.name: Satyagraha House
satyagraha-house.price_text: ≈ ZAR 120–180 tour · check on the day
satyagraha-house.tip: Gandhi lived here. Book a tour in advance as it is a working guesthouse.

steers.name: Steers
steers.tip: Fast-food burgers and famous chips. Quick and cheap between sights.

wimpy.name: Wimpy
wimpy.tip: Classic South African diner for a big breakfast before a long day out.

neighbourgoods-market.name: Neighbourgoods Market (Braamfontein)
neighbourgoods-market.price_text: Entry free · food priced per stall
neighbourgoods-market.tip: Go early for the best food stalls. It gets busy by midday.

maboneng-precinct.name: Maboneng Precinct walk
maboneng-precinct.price_text: Free to walk · guided tours priced separately
maboneng-precinct.hours: Daytime · some venues close after dark
maboneng-precinct.tip: Street art, galleries and cafes. Walk in daylight and keep valuables out of sight.

soweto-tour.name: Guided Soweto tour
soweto-tour.hours: Half-day tours usually morning or afternoon
soweto-tour.tip: A local guide makes the history clear. Confirm pickup and entry fees are included.

melville-7th.name: 7th Street, Melville
melville-7th.price_text: Free to walk · food and drinks priced per venue
melville-7th.hours: Cafes daytime · bars into the evening
melville-7th.tip: A relaxed neighbourhood for lunch and people-watching. Busier on weekends.

rosebank-art.name: Rosebank art and craft walk
rosebank-art.hours: Galleries and markets daytime · check on the day
rosebank-art.tip: Good for African art and crafts. Ask about shipping before you buy large pieces.

zoo-lake.name: Zoo Lake viewpoint
zoo-lake.tip: A green spot for a walk with city views. Go in daylight and in a group.

stays.why: Safest base for first-timers. Gautrain to the airport, malls and restaurants on foot, easy Ubers to the sights.
Gautrain stop, good hotels and the Sunday rooftop market. A calmer, walkable suburb close to the museums.
Downtown arts district with galleries, cafés and street art. Lively by day; take an Uber after dark.
Leafy student neighbourhood with bars and cheap eats on 7th Street. Good value, short drive to town.

food: Try a braai (South African barbecue) and bunny chow, a curry served in a hollowed bread loaf.
Maboneng and Braamfontein have the best café and street-food scene; go at lunchtime and take an Uber back.
Soweto tours often include a lunch stop; ask for a local shisa nyama (grill) spot.
Cheap eats: kota sandwiches, vetkoek and boerewors rolls at markets for around ZAR 40–90.
Book dinner in Sandton or Rosebank. Many kitchens close early; check hours on the day.
more_time: Add a day for Soweto: Vilakazi Street, the Hector Pieterson Museum and a shisa nyama lunch.
History fans can swap a museum for the Cradle of Humankind and Sterkfontein Caves, about an hour's drive.
Add a half-day at the Apartheid Museum and Constitution Hill if you have a third day.
